bug_summary: The recursive-merge guard in the Map branch was narrowed from checking whether the existing value is non-null to checking whether it is a Map, so recursion into an existing value now only happens for Map instances. When a key already holds a Collection (or any other non-Map object) and the incoming JSON supplies an array or object for that key, the old value is discarded and replaced by a freshly deserialized value instead of being merged into. Merging into entries that hold scalars behaves exactly as before, and the existing tests never merge into collection-valued entries, so they still pass.
